logs.summary: Torrential rain starting late on August 13, 2023, caused record-breaking flooding in eastern Japan, particularly in Chiba Prefecture. The flooding resulted in at least eight to nine deaths, widespread power outages affecting over 22,000 households, and stranded thousands of travelers at Tokyo's Narita Airport. Authorities issued the highest-level rain warnings as the region experienced unprecedented rainfall, equivalent to three months' worth in 12 hours.

incidents.summary: A magnitude 5.5 earthquake struck 108 km northeast of Hengchun, Taiwan, at 3:00 p.m. local time on August 25, 2026, according to multiple sources. The Central Weather Administration issued a national alert initially overestimating the quake at magnitude 6.6 before correcting it to 5.8, attributing the error to limited seismic data. The earthquake occurred in waters off Taitung county, with no immediate reports of major damage.
